<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Egypt]] reopens the [[Pyramid of Djoser]] after a 14-year restoration. The pyramid is deemed the oldest stone structure of its size in the world. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/egypts-oldest-pyramid-reopens-public-14-year-restoration/story?id=69411249/ (ABC News)] 

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**British airline [[Flybe (1979–2020)|Flybe]] collapses into [[administration (law)|administration]] with the loss of 2,000 jobs after failing to secure financial support. The airline says the impact of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]] is partly to blame for its collapse. Flybe provided more than half of UK domestic flights outside London. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-51746564 (BBC News)] 
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] drops again almost 1,000 points over coronavirus fears. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/us-stocks-march-5-2020 (Fox Business)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020|United States tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020]]
**The [[National Weather Service]] confirms 13 [[tornado]]es occurred. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/03/04/nashville-tornadoes-what-we-know-deaths-damage-path/4950396002/ (''USA Today'')]
**The tornado in [[Putnam County, Tennessee]], is upgraded to an [[Enhanced Fujita scale|EF4]], becoming the strongest tornado of the outbreak. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/3-still-missing-after-ef-4-tornado-tennessee-s-putnam-n1150221 (NBC News)]
**The [[Enhanced Fujita scale|EF3]] tornado that went through [[Davidson County, Tennessee|Davidson]], [[Wilson County, Tennessee|Wilson]], and [[Smith County, Tennessee|Smith]] counties was confirmed on the ground for {{convert|53.4|miles|km}}, becoming the second longest path a tornado has taken in Tennessee. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/03/05/nashville-tornado-cookeville-ef4/ (''Washington Post'')]
**Every person is accounted for at the end of the day, after three people were missing previously. Official death toll from the outbreak is 25. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/03/05/nashville-tornado-tennessee-residents-help-victims-clean-up/4961781002/ (''USA Today'')]
*At least nine people, of whom four are children, are killed and 60 are injured when a fire at a bakery spreads to a crowded market in a [[refugee camp]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-palestinians-fire/nine-killed-in-gaza-as-bakery-fire-spreads-through-packed-market-idUSKBN20S20K (Reuters)] 

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****Officials in Republika Srpska reports the first case of COVID-19 in the country. [http://ba.n1info.com/English/NEWS/a414110/Bosnia-confirms-its-first-case-of-Coronavirus.html (N1 BA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****The Italian government postpones the [[2020 Italian constitutional referendum|constitutional referendum]], originally scheduled for 29 March. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-italy-referendum/italy-to-postpone-march-29-referendum-on-number-of-lawmakers-due-to-coronavirus-sources-idUSKBN20S1SE (Reuters)] [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2020/03/05/coronavirus-referendum-put-off_4b419864-1383-4323-bac0-49e772e19871.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in England, after a woman in her 70s with underlying health conditions dies at [[Royal Berkshire Hospital]] in [[Reading, Berkshire]], as the number of confirmed cases of the virus rises to over 100. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-51759602 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Consultative Assembly]] member and former [[Ambassador]] to [[Syria]], [[Hossein Sheikholeslam]], dies after becoming infected with [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. Iran suspends its parliament indefinitely. [https://www.businessinsider.com/another-senior-iranian-politician-has-died-of-coronavirus-2020-3?r=US&IR=T (''Business Insider'')]

;Law and crime
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] overturns on appeal a previous decision to block an investigation into [[war crime]]s allegedly committed by [[United States Army|U.S. troops]], the [[Taliban]] and the [[Afghan government]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51751717 (BBC News)]
*[[Russian military intervention in Ukraine (2014–present)]]
**A court in Russian-controlled [[Republic of Crimea (Russia)|Crimea]] sentences a [[Jehovah's Witnesses|Jehovah's Witness]] to six-years imprisonment for activities of a banned extremist organization, part of a crackdown that activists say violates religious freedom. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-politics-religion/court-in-crimea-jails-jehovahs-witness-for-six-years-in-extremism-case-idUSKBN20S0O1 (Reuters)]
*The Republican-controlled [[Arizona House of Representatives]] passes a bill banning [[transgender female]]s from [[women's sports]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/us/arizona-house-gop-passes-transgender-bill-to-protect-girls-in-sports (Fox News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Dominican Republic municipal elections]], [[2020 Dominican Republic protests]]
**The pots-and-pans protest continue in front of [[Pontificia Universidad Católica Madre y Maestra]] where the meeting of the Economic and Social Council with the political parties was to take place. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/03/04/pots-and-pans-protest-scraps-high-level-talks-in-dominican-capital/ (''Dominican Today'')]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**After failing to win any states on [[Results_of_the_2020_Democratic_Party_presidential_primaries#Super_Tuesday|Super Tuesday]], [[Massachusetts]] [[U.S. Senator]] [[Elizabeth Warren]] suspends [[Elizabeth Warren 2020 presidential campaign|her presidential campaign]], leaving Hawaii [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[Tulsi Gabbard]] as the only woman left in the race. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/05/us/politics/elizabeth-warren-drops-out.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-warren/elizabeth-warren-suspends-2020-democratic-white-house-bid-new-york-times-citing-sources-idUSKBN20S21S (Reuters)]
